messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Where is source code of HMC?
parts:
Source and doc for everything in Stan is linked from
our home page: http://mc-stan.org

You can use Stan through its interfaces to change the
target Metropolis accept rate of static HMC. But given
a step size (discretization interval) and number of steps
(simulation time / discretization interval), the Metropolis
algorithm dictates how you do accept/reject decisions.

- Bob
